 2027 Festival of Speed dates revealed
 30th October 2026 
 Rachel Roberts 
 The dates for the 2027 Goodwood Festival of Speed have now been revealed!
 Festival of Speed
 Explore tickets
 Find out more
 After a spectacular four-day celebration this summer, we can now look forward to doing it all again when the Festival of Speed returns on 15 th -18 th July 2027.
 Tickets will go on sale for GRRC Members on Saturday 31 st October 2026. Fellowship Members will be able to purchase tickets from Monday 2 nd November.
 For the public, tickets will be on general sale from Monday 9 th November.
 Image credit: Tom Shaxson 
 You can  join the Fellowship today to secure your tickets at the earliest opportunity,   plus enjoy access to the exclusive GRRC Pit Stop Enclosure on-event, ten per cent off admission tickets and grandstand passes and a year-round calendar of member events.
 As always, we’ll bring you all the plans for next year’s event as they are revealed, just as with the Goodwood Revival presented by Dunlop and the 84th Members’ Meeting presented by Audrain Motorsport. 
 Main image photography by Jayson Fong. 
 The 2027 Festival of Speed will take place on 15th-18th July 2027, sign up for ticket alerts to make sure you don't miss out. Tickets are available for GRRC Members and Fellows, you can join the Fellowship today.
